subject: [PATCH v1 3/3] mm/readahead: avoid per-folio memcg reclaim

2026-10-03.patch_summary: This patch modifies the readahead mechanism to avoid per-folio memory cgroup (memcg) reclaim, which was causing livelocks and high CPU usage on systems with many tasks faulting in the same cgroup. Instead of charging each folio separately, the patch adds multiple folios to the page cache at once without direct reclaim, and only reclaims for the rest of the window when the memcg is at its limit. If the memcg hits its limit again before adding all folios, it attempts one more time. If there's still no room, readahead stops early rather than trying harder. This change affects only speculative readahead folios and does not alter behavior for actual fault or read requests.
